text: The City Clerk's Office received notice that Bahar Shadpour resigned from the Housing Rights Advisory Committee effective January 6, 2025. Staff from the Public Appointments Secretariat in the City Clerk's Office are leading a process to recruit applicants and help bring a nominated candidate to City Council for their consideration.
The Housing Rights Advisory Committee accepted the resignation of Bahar Shadpour as a member effective January 6, 2025.
